title: Japanese Chirashi Sushi with Caramelized Onions
description: A simple and flavorful dish showcasing chirashi, onions, and lightly buttery goodness. A perfect combination of Japanese flavors.
instructions: Cook the lightly buttery rice according to package instructions.
Caramelize the onion in a pan with a little sesame oil until golden brown.
In a separate pan, combine chirashi, soy sauce, and sushi vinegar. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until heated through.
In a large bowl, combine cooked rice, caramelized onion, and chirashi mixture.
Season with sesame seeds and brown sugar to taste.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
